info.name: Library SOAP API
info.description: Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner / newman). Creates test data, exercises every operation and fault, then deletes the test data.

item.name: Framework fault - id is not an integer

exec: pm.test('Rejected by CoreWCF before our code runs (DeserializationFailed)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('DeserializationFailed'));

request.description: Shows the difference between our typed faults and faults produced by the SOAP framework itself: the XML could not be turned into an int, so LibraryService is never called.
